name: Elspeth Tirel
description: Elspeth Tirel is a human knight and planeswalker, taken captive by the Phyrexians as a child, who searched for a new home and was later reborn as an archangel.

summary.text: Elspeth Tirel is a human knight and planeswalker, taken captive by the Phyrexians as a child, who searched for a new home and was later reborn as an archangel.

bio.text: As a child her plane is invaded by the Phyrexians and she is taken captive, and she escapes when her Spark ignites and begins searching for a new home.
On Theros she cuts Xenagos from the sky with Godsend, and Heliod then murders her with it.
She returns from death and arrives in New Capenna, where she becomes a Maestros officer to learn how the city survived the Phyrexians.
At Urza's tower she defends the Temporal Anchor with Jodah against a Phyrexian attack and joins the strike team to New Phyrexia.
In New Phyrexia she refuses to join her compleated mentor Ajani, defeats him, then runs Jace through and vanishes with the activated sylex.
Serra remakes her as a winged angel, and she fights Elesh Norn so the Mirrans can escape.
As an archangel she travels to Tarkir to ask how it kept dragonstorms at bay, where she forgives Ajani and makes a last stand against Sarkhan.

status.text: Elspeth is alive as an archangel, and her last major event shows Ajani catching her after Sarkhan clasps her in his jaws while they plan to blind him.

timeline.summary: Flashback: from Kruphix's Temple, Kydele watches Xenagos become a god and Elspeth, with Ajani, use Godsend to cut him from the sky.
timeline.quote: She saw Elspeth use the blade called Godsend to cut Xenagos from the sky.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Heliod snatches Godsend from Elspeth and murders her with it, claiming a champion cannot know more than her god.
timeline.quote: And then he murdered her, his own champion, with her own weapon.

timeline.summary: Kruphix reveals that Theros is one of many worlds and that world-walkers like Elspeth, Ajani, Kiora and Xenagos have walked between them.
timeline.quote: So was the triton—the merfolk—Kiora, who called herself Callaphe and earned the ire of Thassa.

timeline.summary: Kruphix reveals his fear: threats from the Eldrazi, an ancient dragon planeswalker and Phyrexia could destroy Theros while even the gods are powerless.
timeline.quote: even the gods may be powerless to stop them.

timeline.summary: Ajani recalls that Elspeth left Dominaria for Mirrodin, which other planeswalkers now say is dead with Phyrexia returned.
timeline.quote: Then other Planeswalkers had spread the word: Mirrodin is dead. Phyrexia has returned.

timeline.summary: Ajani asks Brimaz for help finding his friend Elspeth, and Brimaz points him to Lanathos.
timeline.quote: You should talk to Lanathos," said Brimaz.

timeline.summary: Ajani introduces himself to Lanathos and asks about Elspeth; Lanathos eagerly asks where Ajani is from.
timeline.quote: There are people across the mountains? Leonin and human?

timeline.summary: Ajani realizes the latest Champion may be Elspeth, and Lanathos says she was seen at Akros, besieged by minotaurs.
timeline.quote: After she slew Polukranos, the Champion was spotted at Akros, which has been besieged by a horde of minotaurs.

timeline.summary: Ajani resolves to find Elspeth and help her.
timeline.quote: After all, the Champion always has companions.

timeline.summary: Kiora leaps onto the back of Arixmethes and reveals to Ajani and Elspeth that she is not Callaphe, then leaves them to the Monsoon.
timeline.quote: "Not even close," Kiora replied, smiling back at him.

timeline.summary: Kiora rises with her armada and sees Thassa on the Monsoon; Thassa sends Elspeth and Ajani away on a great wave.
timeline.quote: Thassa stepped off the deck of the Monsoon

timeline.summary: Tamiyo privately asks Ajani where Elspeth is and he says she is not coming.
timeline.quote: Where is Elspeth?

timeline.summary: Ajani confesses to Nashi that Elspeth is dead and that he lost her.
timeline.quote: Elspeth is dead.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells the children Elspeth's story, saying a monster struck her down in front of him.
timeline.quote: another monster struck her down

timeline.summary: Ajani whispers that it should have been him, not Elspeth, and the children comfort him.
timeline.quote: It should have been me. Not her.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Heliod runs Elspeth through with Godsend and orders Ajani to carry her to Erebos.
timeline.quote: "Carry her back to the mortal realm, leonin. Deliver her to Erebos,"

timeline.summary: Ajani carries the dying Elspeth to Theros, then leaves to find help as she sees a flash of light cleaving the heavens.
timeline.quote: The last thing she saw was a flash of light, cleaving the heavens in two.

timeline.summary: Elspeth arrives in New Capenna, wondering whether this is the home Ajani said it would be.
timeline.quote: "Home," Elspeth murmured, seeing if the word fit New Capenna when said aloud.

timeline.summary: Elspeth survives by taking odd jobs in New Capenna, still feeling the hollow left by Godsend.
timeline.quote: She kept her head down and took odd jobs throughout the city as she could find them.

timeline.summary: A leonin bumps into Elspeth, triggering a memory of her reunion with Ajani on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: "You're alive!" Ajani raced to her.

timeline.summary: In the memory, Elspeth tells Ajani how she tricked Heliod into a second confrontation, letting Erebos imprison him.
timeline.quote: she gave Erebos, God of the Dead, an opportunity to imprison Heliod.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Elspeth that home is a feeling, not a place; she bristles and walks away.
timeline.quote: "Elspeth, home is not a place; it is a feeling.

timeline.summary: Elspeth hears the shopkeeper being beaten over a debt and intervenes against four Maestro enforcers.
timeline.quote: "Anyone who finds sadistic pleasure in beating up an unarmed man makes themselves my business."

timeline.summary: Elspeth leads the Maestro enforcers on a chase through the Mezzio and ends up cornered at a half-built bridge.
timeline.quote: The road she'd been running down ended abruptly, a half-finished bridge extending out into empty air.

timeline.summary: Elspeth grabs a steel rod and knocks out all four enforcers without killing them.
timeline.quote: rendered him unconscious with a thud

timeline.summary: Anhelo applauds, offers Elspeth work with the Maestros and mentions Halo.
timeline.quote: Why don't you start with the Maestros?

timeline.summary: Anhelo shows Elspeth a fountain statue of an angel fighting a spined creature, which Elspeth recognizes as a Phyrexian.
timeline.quote: Anhelo might not know what it was, but she certainly did.

timeline.summary: In the memory, Ajani reveals he found her home, New Capenna, and asks her to learn how it survived a past Phyrexian incursion.
timeline.quote: "There are rumors of a past incursion there, and since New Capenna is still standing, that means they defeated the previous threat."

timeline.summary: Elspeth planeswalks to New Capenna after Ajani's farewell.
timeline.quote: She didn't look back as she planeswalked away, headed for what she hoped was home.

timeline.summary: Elspeth reluctantly accepts the Maestros' offer to gain information on the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: "All right," Elspeth reluctantly agreed.

timeline.summary: Elspeth works as a museum recruit, cataloguing artwork that hints at Phyrexians, and decides the curator Xander knows more.
timeline.quote: The leader of the Maestros wasn't collecting all these relics by chance.

timeline.summary: Xander tells Elspeth that to learn more she must work for it, and she agrees to take jobs that make her a true member of the family.
timeline.quote: She met his eyes. "I'm ready."

timeline.summary: Elspeth delivers a sealed package to an Obscura door in the Mezzio.
timeline.quote: Elspeth placed the package in her palm and promptly left.

timeline.summary: Xander tells Elspeth that New Capenna was founded by a deal between archangels and demonlords against an unknown enemy, and that he is one of the original signers.
timeline.quote: "Yes, I am, indeed, one of those original signers and have willingly become part demon

timeline.summary: Elspeth tails a Maestros informant across rooftops to a door in a shadowed alcove.
timeline.quote: The vampire knocked on the door and waited.

timeline.summary: Raccoonfolk ambush Elspeth in an alley and she bowls them over.
timeline.quote: she spun and used him like a battering ram to bowl over the others.

timeline.summary: Xander gives Elspeth Halo to drink, describing it as the last gift of the angels.
timeline.quote: "Halo was the last gift of the angels."

timeline.summary: At a Park Heights drop-off, Elspeth meets the planeswalker Vivien, who promises information on a looming threat.
timeline.quote: "One most certainly is, and we share motivations. I'm Vivien, by the way."

timeline.summary: Elspeth declines to leave with Vivien, wanting to learn how New Capennans beat the threat; Vivien agrees to contact her later.
timeline.quote: "I'll look further into these matters also and contact you when I have more information."

timeline.summary: Xander tells Elspeth about the Adversary and the Cabaretti's Font, and orders her to infiltrate the Cabaretti and leave a door unlocked.
timeline.quote: tell me where the Font is kept and leave a door unlocked.

timeline.summary: Xander names Elspeth an officer of the Maestros and gives her a knife; she demands full access to his archives in return for this last job.
timeline.quote: "Do this for me, and all the knowledge in my archives will be yours."

timeline.summary: Dressed in Xander's tailored outfit, Elspeth visits a Cabaretti cabaret looking for work and is rebuffed by the bartender Rocco.
timeline.quote: Rocco gave her a look that said, Who do you think you are? and promptly walked away.

timeline.summary: Kitt Kanto takes Elspeth to Jinnie, who agrees to give her a few small jobs for the Crescendo.
timeline.quote: "Then I think I have a few small jobs for you.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reveals a head of Elspeth Tirel in the garden, saying they first encountered her on Theros and sought her in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: "Her name is Elspeth Tirel."

timeline.summary: Norn resolves to find Elspeth Tirel and rid the Multiverse of her.
timeline.quote: she would need to find the human, Elspeth Tirel, and rid the Multiverse of her.

timeline.summary: Elspeth asks where Ajani is and Teferi tells her; she reacts with grief and silence.
timeline.quote: Where is Ajani?

timeline.summary: Kaya briefs the group on the plan: the other planes are mobilizing and the Coalition will join Koth's Mirrans in assaulting the Phyrexian core.
timeline.quote: Without a head, the body will fail.

timeline.summary: Elspeth calls the plan a death sentence and storms out.
timeline.quote: That's a death sentence,

timeline.summary: Elspeth apologizes to Teferi, and he tells her about Ajani's compleation.
timeline.quote: I was there with him when it happened—when the compleation took hold.

timeline.summary: Teferi shares mitab fruit with Elspeth and tells her that everything he does is about saving his daughter Niambi.
timeline.quote: Everything I'm doing is about saving her .

timeline.summary: Elspeth offers to stay and defend them, and Teferi welcomes her.
timeline.quote: If you'll have me.

timeline.summary: Elspeth's sword glows and Teferi recalls his father's story of the wattle-eyes, choosing to believe.
timeline.quote: This time, Teferi chose to believe.

timeline.summary: Ajani gives Tezzeret his cloak, once worn by Elspeth, and Tezzeret suspects the true Ajani remains suppressed within.
timeline.quote: it was the same cloak once worn by Elspeth Tirel.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, unable to sleep, drills in the tower's grand hall and admits her skills feel sluggish after New Capenna.
timeline.quote: But after all her experiences on New Capenna, her movements had felt sluggish, her sword arm shaky.

timeline.summary: Wrenn tells Elspeth she lives two melodies, one in light and one in shadow, and Elspeth angrily denies it.
timeline.quote: It is as if you live two separate lives. One in light, one in shadow.

timeline.summary: Wrenn senses visitors, and Elspeth confronts two figures glowing green in the rain.
timeline.quote: Are you Elspeth?

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra arrive at the tower and Elspeth hands them to Kaya for debriefing.
timeline.quote: Nissa Revane and Chandra Nalaar walked into the light.

timeline.summary: At a watchtower, Elspeth sets up one of Saheeli's cylinder turrets and tries to pray, remembering that Ajani is compleated.
timeline.quote: Elspeth pulled a steel-clad cylinder from her sack

timeline.summary: Elspeth speaks quietly to Giada about her hatred for the Phyrexians and her failures.
timeline.quote: And I hate them so much for what they did to Ajani.

timeline.summary: Elspeth joins them and speaks of Venser; Jodah reveals he is four thousand years old, and Chandra vows to save Ajani and burn the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: We're going to save him.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian attack begins at night; Elspeth finds Saheeli and Kaya straining to keep the Anchor running for Teferi.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian attack came in the dead of night.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian skyship overpowers the watchtowers, and Elspeth orders Wrenn and Nissa to protect Teferi.
timeline.quote: Wrenn and Nissa, protect Teferi at all costs.

timeline.summary: Elspeth wakes the mechanical garrison and clay brutes and sets them in defense arcs.
timeline.quote: All at once, the hundred or so mechanical soldiers stomped to life

timeline.summary: Jodah unveils a staked trench and fire to impale the Phyrexian vanguard, and Elspeth and Jodah charge with powerstone lances that unleash scything bands of energy.
timeline.quote: Jodah unwove the phantasmal terrain spell he'd cast the previous day

timeline.summary: Elspeth fights through the horde with her sword and Halo, then orders the mechanical legion to charge.
timeline.quote: Upon hearing the command word, the metal legion defending the keep turned into aggressors

timeline.summary: The skyship unfolds into a giant legged behemoth heading for the tower.
timeline.quote: Several more gargantuan legs sprouted from the bottom of the skyship's hull

timeline.summary: Jodah leads Elspeth in casting Jaya's spell, and she channels her hope of saving Ajani, producing a blaze that destroys the behemoth.
timeline.quote: A column of radiance poured out of her

timeline.summary: Ashiok's letter recounts how Elspeth and a prisoner called Boy tried to hide among corpses in a Phyrexian asylum on New Capenna; Boy was caught and Phyrexianized.
timeline.quote: Thanks to your Planeswalker spark, you escaped, but Boy wasn't as fortunate.

timeline.summary: Rona appears, blasts Elspeth and Jodah with lightning, and stabs Jodah in the gut as revenge for Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: This is for the trouble you caused me in Yavimaya,

timeline.summary: Elspeth wounds Rona with her sword, though her arm is run through by the glaive.
timeline.quote: burying her sword deep into Rona's shoulder.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrives, spares Elspeth, tells her to disappear before the tower falls, and carries off Rona.
timeline.quote: I suggest you take this opportunity to find somewhere remote and disappear.

timeline.summary: A pillar of light scorches the sky and steam covers the vale, leaving Elspeth and Jodah's fate unknown.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, a pillar of light scorched the sky outside the tower like a sun ascending

timeline.summary: Jodah and Elspeth stagger in alive; Elspeth announces she will go to New Phyrexia and Jodah will stay to free Teferi.
timeline.quote: Then I'm coming with you.

timeline.summary: Elspeth wakes alone on New Phyrexia and fights off six Phyrexians until Kaya joins her.
timeline.quote: a purple-tinged blade thrust through a Phyrexian heart

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Kaya descend through the lacuna with Kaya carrying a stray tanuki-shaped robot.
timeline.quote: From there, they had continued toward the white lacuna

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Kaya emerge from the lacuna into the Furnace Layer and spot the Mirran camp.
timeline.quote: True to its name, the Furnace Layer burned .

timeline.summary: Elspeth is reunited with Koth, whom she thought dead.
timeline.quote: Koth, I thought you were dead!

timeline.summary: Elspeth, hearing Karn and Ajani are missing, notes that both know too much about the sylex.
timeline.quote: Ajani destroyed the last one.

timeline.summary: Koth explains the route down through the Hunter Maze and Surgical Bay to land in the Dross Pits above the Fair Basilica.
timeline.quote: We'll bypass both to land in the Dross Pits, directly above the Fair Basilica.

timeline.summary: Koth describes the Mirrans' dire survival and resolve; Elspeth apologizes for leaving.
timeline.quote: As long as one of us is breathing, we'll keep fighting back.

timeline.summary: Koth introduces hexgold, a Mirran metal that protects somewhat against phyresis, and offers it for the team's gear.
timeline.quote: Our gear has been treated with a substance we call hexgold.

timeline.summary: Koth announces he will join the descent with a demolition team as a backup if the sylex fails.
timeline.quote: I have a demolition team standing by to do what needs to be done if your sylex fails.

timeline.summary: Jace and Kaya leave by hand-pumped cart into the tunnel to the Dross Pits, and the rest follow.
timeline.quote: made her own descent into the shadows of New Phyrexia

timeline.summary: The carts plunge down the tunnel and Elspeth chats with the Mirran operators about the Hunter Maze and Surgical Bay the team is bypassing.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex transported the worst of it beneath the surface during the great transformation

timeline.summary: The team lands in the Dross Pits, a rotting landscape of necrogen pools.
timeline.quote: Pools of glowing green liquid she recognized as necrogen dominated the landscape

timeline.summary: Elspeth distributes Halo, and Jace collapses after drinking his dose.
timeline.quote: the bottle slipping from his fingers before he collapsed backward onto the cart behind him

timeline.summary: Jace breaks free of Tyvar and strides off alone; the group abandons its safe route and follows him because he carries the sylex.
timeline.quote: He has the sylex. If we lose that, we lose everything.

timeline.summary: Jace uses illusions so that Phyrexians locked in civil war cannot see the group as they cross the battlefield.
timeline.quote: When they look at us, they see nothing at all,

timeline.summary: Jace runs into the coliseum and the others follow; Kaito wants to recover the sylex, but Elspeth insists on saving their own.
timeline.quote: What's the value of fighting at all, if we can't even make the stand to save our own?

timeline.summary: The group finds Vraska, gravely wounded and surrounded by Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: bleeding profusely from a dozen terrible wounds, stood Vraska.

timeline.summary: Koth, Nahiri, Elspeth, Kaito and Tyvar fight the Phyrexians in the coliseum while Jace crosses unseen to Vraska.
timeline.quote: The remaining Phyrexians never stood a chance against her

timeline.summary: Outside the coliseum, the group is cornered by massed Phyrexian ranks.
timeline.quote: They stepped straight into the middle of a war.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and the others regroup in the rubble, finding a hole in the sky and that Nahiri has vanished.
timeline.quote: Nahiri was nowhere to be seen.

timeline.summary: Jace, burned by Vraska's venom, asks for the sylex back, and Melira cannot heal him here.
timeline.quote: I'm not going to survive this as it stands, I may as well be the one to trigger the blast.

timeline.summary: Kaya relents and hands Jace the sylex, and the group sets off toward Norn's altar.
timeline.quote: until finally, with a disgusted expression, she shoved it into his arms

timeline.summary: The survivors hurry across the Fair Basilica's bridges, mourning Nahiri's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: We have to keep moving to honor the ending she chose.

timeline.summary: Melira reveals Nahiri had asked for help at the Furnace, and that curing phyresis would have sidelined her for days.
timeline.quote: Repairing her body from the damage already done would have left her incapacitated for days.

timeline.summary: Kaito says he hopes Nahiri is dead rather than turned against them.
timeline.quote: I just hope she's dead,

timeline.summary: Melira leads them to the infectious gateway into the Seedcore.
timeline.quote: The gateway into the Seedcore. It infects anything it touches.

timeline.summary: Tyvar spreads Glimmervoid metal over the entire group and Kaito lifts the oil so they can pass through the gateway safely.
timeline.quote: until his body was a Glimmervoid metal sculpture.

timeline.summary: A flash from the upper branches signals that the World Tree has connected to the Multiverse and the invasion has begun.
timeline.quote: The World Tree has connected to the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: The group finds Karn vivisected and bound at the center of the root chamber.
timeline.quote: The great silver golem had been broken open, vivisected, and spread across the platform.

timeline.summary: Karn tells them the invasion is still young and that they must detonate the sylex at the root source.
timeline.quote: You will need to get to the root source and detonate it.

timeline.summary: Koth and Melira stay behind to free Karn while Elspeth goes on, refusing to run any more.
timeline.quote: No more running.

timeline.summary: Compleated Ajani and Tibalt approach on the bridge, with Ajani urging Elspeth to join Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: came Ajani and Tibalt, but not as they had known them.

timeline.summary: Elspeth refuses to join Ajani, who invokes Phyrexia's promise of unity.
timeline.quote: All will be One.

timeline.summary: Tyvar confronts Tibalt and tells Kaito to take the others on to the root source.
timeline.quote: Elspeth and I will handle the vermin.

timeline.summary: Kaito, Kaya and Jace leave, and Elspeth and Tyvar begin their battle against Ajani and Tibalt.
timeline.quote: and the battle was joined.

timeline.summary: On the bridge, Ajani urges Elspeth to join Phyrexia, then attacks her with his axe.
timeline.quote: You do not need to be alive to join Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Tibalt's doubt overwhelms Elspeth, who is disarmed by Ajani and backs away.
timeline.quote: Ajani's next blow knocked the weapon from her hands

timeline.summary: Elspeth's will returns, she blocks Ajani's blow, and Tyvar's magic suppresses Tibalt and the doubt he spreads.
timeline.quote: Your doubt can't touch what it can't reach.

timeline.summary: Elspeth blasts Ajani back with white light and knocks him unconscious.
timeline.quote: driving him to the ground

timeline.summary: Tyvar kills Tibalt by driving his own tail barbs through his chest and throwing him from the bridge, as Elspeth runs to find the others.
timeline.quote: Tyvar driving the twin barbs of Tibalt's tail into the space that should have held the Phyrexian's heart.

timeline.summary: Elspeth drops through the ceiling and runs Jace through with her sword, taking the sylex.
timeline.quote: she drove her blade through Jace and shoved him aside

timeline.summary: Elspeth vanishes with the activated sylex, bound for a point beyond the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: The sylex went with her, bound for some unknown destination, some point beyond the Blind Eternities.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Norn that the Planeswalkers' new leader is Elspeth Tirel, wielding a blade of white light, and Norn grows fearful.
timeline.quote: The leader's name is Elspeth Tirel.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret sends Estel with the box and an enchanted knife to Bant, telling him to say an ally of Elspeth Tirel sent him.
timeline.quote: When you see Rafiq, tell him that an ally of Elspeth Tirel sent you.

timeline.summary: Kaya explains that Elspeth ran Jace through and took the sylex into the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Elspeth ran him through, picked up the sylex and planeswalked into the Blind Eternities.

timeline.summary: Elspeth wakes inside a memory in her childhood dungeon and kills a Phyrexian-like beast to save the girl, her younger self, standing over her slain mother.
timeline.quote: This time, she does what the girl could only dream of doing. This time, she has a sword.

timeline.summary: The girl speaks with an adult voice and warns that a splicer is coming; Elspeth realizes the girl is her younger self and is told to wake up.
timeline.quote: "Elspeth, it's time to wake up."

timeline.summary: Elspeth is told by the voice, now in her mother's likeness, that she must make one more choice about where to intervene as the planes burn.
timeline.quote: You must choose where to intervene,

timeline.summary: Elspeth is shown the Phyrexian assault on New Capenna led by the corrupted angel Atraxa.
timeline.quote: "They call her Atraxa."

timeline.summary: Elspeth finds she cannot affect events as an observer, even as Phyrexian beasts slaughter citizens.
timeline.quote: She tries to save the man only for her hands to fade through him.

timeline.summary: Riveteers fight back in Park Heights, and Elspeth decides New Capenna has its defenders and is not the place to intervene.
timeline.quote: "This isn't the place," she says.

timeline.summary: Elspeth falls to Theros and is welcomed by Daxos's voice; she sees Meletis in ruins.
timeline.quote: "So you've not forgotten me, even with the new station,"

timeline.summary: Elspeth sees Ajani in Heliod's temple, converting gods and forcing a priestess to drink Phyrexian oil.
timeline.quote: He's already changed three of them.

timeline.summary: Heroes of Theros shoot at Ajani, and he has a captured youth killed before the faithful.
timeline.quote: "Behold, one who turns away from the pack! One who plots against us!"

timeline.summary: Elspeth weighs saving Theros against the larger war, and concludes the choice is not meant to be about her own wants.
timeline.quote: But this isn't meant to be about her own wants and needs.

timeline.summary: Elspeth falls through other planes and lands at the Invasion Tree on Mirrodin, which Jin-Gitaxias's army fills.
timeline.quote: The Invasion Tree stands as proud testament to the unending triumphs of Elesh Norn.

timeline.summary: Norn tells the Mirrans that they will be freed of their skin's treachery; Elspeth reaches for her sword.
timeline.quote: Elspeth reaches for her sword.

timeline.summary: The voice tells Elspeth that killing Norn will not end the threat, and recounts the tale of the woman in white who made a world of angels.
timeline.quote: Killing her will not end this.

timeline.summary: Time stops; Serra appears among the prisoners and reveals the choice is whether Elspeth keeps Nissa occupied long enough for Wrenn to reach the tree.
timeline.quote: It's to keep Nissa occupied long enough for Wrenn to reach the tree.

timeline.summary: Elspeth tells Serra she is afraid, and Serra embraces her, tells her fear is last to leave and remakes her.
timeline.quote: "Fear is always the last thing to leave,"

timeline.summary: Elspeth is reborn with wings and returns to time as Jin-Gitaxias attacks, meeting his claws with her sword.
timeline.quote: She is Elspeth, and she is not.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Karn recalls leaving word not to follow him when he first tried to solve Mirrodin's Phyrexian problem, and being saved by Venser's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: If it wasn't for Venser sacrificing his spark, Karn would be dead.

timeline.summary: Elspeth arrives as an angel in golden armor, blocking Jin-Gitaxias's strike and sending his legions into the abyss.
timeline.quote: An angel in gleaming armor, a golden blade now raised to counter Jin-Gitaxias's strike.

timeline.summary: Elspeth heals Chandra and Koth while Norn rages, throwing pieces of her throne that shatter against Elspeth's wing.
timeline.quote: Healing light flows from her into the pyromancer.

timeline.summary: Norn pulls Elspeth from the air and builds new armor from fallen Phyrexians, while Elspeth burns it with a beam from Godsend.
timeline.quote: A little focus is all it takes to send a searing beam of light at Norn.

timeline.summary: Norn raises walls to block Elspeth and tries to persuade her that her wings make her a Phyrexian.
timeline.quote: What does this form offer you that Phyrexia cannot?

timeline.summary: Elspeth is tempted by Norn's vision of unity with friends such as Ajani and Daxos, but denies they are alike.
timeline.quote: And though she is loath to admit it, there is truth to what Norn is saying.

timeline.summary: Norn tears off Jin-Gitaxias's arm for suggesting she compleat Elspeth, and Elspeth stabs Norn's shoulder, making her bleed and escaping her grip.
timeline.quote: She drives her sword into Norn's wounded shoulder

timeline.summary: Elspeth argues that Norn wants worship for herself, not Phyrexia, enraging Norn who hurls blades.
timeline.quote: Power's the only thing you care about.

timeline.summary: Elspeth dodges Norn's blade storm with a sharp turn and unleashes a ray of light, then flies toward the tree to ensure Wrenn and Chandra make it.
timeline.quote: With all her problems concentrated in one place, Elspeth at last unleashes a ray of light.

timeline.summary: A golden angel strikes Nissa with light, forcing her to drop Chandra, whom the angel sets on the platform.
timeline.quote: the angel catches Chandra and sets her on the platform.

timeline.summary: Wrenn grows a massive portal as Elspeth is flung through the gate by a war engine, and the Phyrexian army pours through into Zhalfir's peaceful land.
timeline.quote: The monstrosity flings the angel through the gate

timeline.summary: Koth seeks advice from Elspeth about Melira's plan and whether Ajani and Nissa deserve mercy.
timeline.quote: "It's going to kill her, doing that," Koth says.

timeline.summary: Elspeth tells Koth that Melira chooses her end freely and urges him to make Zhalfir home, then flies him to the ward.
timeline.quote: "You will try to make this place home. It will welcome you, if you let it."

timeline.summary: Giada leads the angels' charge across the Multiverse and speaks with Elspeth on New Phyrexia, promising help.
timeline.quote: That's just what I wanted to tell you. Some of us are coming to help.

timeline.summary: Elspeth tells Teferi to leave Nissa to her and to hold off Jin-Gitaxias and Norn.
timeline.quote: "Leave Nissa to me.

timeline.summary: Nissa attacks Chandra and Koth, and Elspeth knocks her out of her armor and sky; Chandra catches her.
timeline.quote: The elf drops like a stone out of her armor, and out of the sky.

timeline.summary: An archangel shields Vin from the dragon's fire.
timeline.quote: Hovering before Vin is an angel.

timeline.summary: Nissa sees Elspeth fighting the dragon.
timeline.quote: Elspeth's got the dragon handled.

timeline.summary: Elspeth heals Chandra's injuries with concentrated light.
timeline.quote: Concentrated light illuminates Chandra's forehead, her back, her ribs

timeline.summary: Elspeth warns that a storm of primordial magic is leaving dragons on planes that never knew them.
timeline.quote: A raging storm of primordial magic has been flowing between worlds, leaving dragons in its wake.

timeline.summary: Elspeth blesses Chandra and Nissa and vanishes in a flash.
timeline.quote: And many blessings on your relationship.

timeline.summary: Narset names the visitor as Elspeth and fears something terrible has happened.
timeline.quote: Her name is Elspeth,

timeline.summary: Elspeth arrives on the Jeskai skyship Storm Crane and a small child asks if she is a dragon, frightening her mother.
timeline.quote: And you have four other limbs

timeline.summary: Narset greets Elspeth, who explains that dragonstorms have begun appearing across the Multiverse and asks how Tarkir kept them at bay.
timeline.quote: Dragonstorms have begun appearing throughout the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Narset reflects on Ajani, Tamiyo and her lost spark, and Elspeth recalls the cost of bringing Ajani and Nissa back.
timeline.quote: It cost everything to bring him and Nissa back.

timeline.summary: Narset shows a map of how Tarkir's dragonstorms have become more potent, with reports of scales growing on the steppes and new, hungrier dragons.
timeline.quote: So much so, they've begun to reshape Tarkir itself,

timeline.summary: Narset refuses to modify the ritual and confesses that it may have destabilized Tarkir's balance and caused a chain reaction.
timeline.quote: it may have destabilized the delicate balance in Tarkir, resulting in a chain reaction.

timeline.summary: Bells ring and Narset announces that a wild dragon is inside the school.
timeline.quote: There's a wild dragon inside the school !

timeline.summary: Narset and Elspeth find the dragon, which has gored through the hull and is closing on six trapped youths behind a girl's barrier.
timeline.quote: it had gored its way up through the ship's hull, chewed its way through wood and metal.

timeline.summary: Elspeth dives into the dragon's mouth and drives her sword into its skull as monks rescue the children.
timeline.quote: Elspeth dove headfirst into the open maw, sword held out like a beacon.

timeline.summary: The wounded dragon flees to the deck and then off the ship while skyriders engage it.
timeline.quote: It began to writhe back, struggling to escape its attackers

timeline.summary: Elspeth says she will respect Narset's decision, and Narset promises one in the morning.
timeline.quote: I'll give you my decision in the morning.

timeline.summary: After the damage count, Narset gives Elspeth a guest room and Elspeth says Ajani spoke kindly of her.
timeline.quote: Ajani said very kind things about you.

timeline.summary: Taigam warns that Elspeth is an omen and that her arrival may have provoked the attack, and urges Narset to send her away.
timeline.quote: Send her away, Narset. As far away from the Jeskai as it is possible,

timeline.summary: Narset tells Elspeth the Jeskai cannot help, then reveals she will go herself.
timeline.quote: But I can.

timeline.summary: Narset sneaks away from the monastery with Elspeth on a young dragon eager to join the quest.
timeline.quote: And so Narset saddled the young dragon

timeline.summary: At the Crucible Narset recalls the battle against the dragonlords on Shiko, and shows Elspeth the floating hedrons.
timeline.quote: Ugin taught her how to shape them.

timeline.summary: A mysterious voice calls them to a temple as a dragonstorm gathers overhead; Narset sends her dragon away.
timeline.quote: Above, a storm began to gather, serrated clouds giving way to the suggestion of eyes, bared teeth.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan emerges at the Crucible, saying he is looking for hope in the dragonstorm and that all the Multiverse will become a realm of dragons.
timeline.quote: All of the Multiverse will become a realm of dragons.

timeline.summary: Elspeth easily defeats Sarkhan, and Narset blasts him when he springs up to stab Elspeth in the back.
timeline.quote: The blast sent Sarkhan crashing to the ground ten feet away, panting and boneless and stunned.

timeline.summary: Elspeth sheathes her sword and warns Sarkhan she will kill him if he attacks again.
timeline.quote: If you attack us again, I'll kill you.

timeline.summary: Abzan outriders arrest Narset and Elspeth near the stormplains and take them to Arashin for questioning.
timeline.quote: Incarceration by the Abzan was not part of Narset's plan.

timeline.summary: Narset persuades an impatient Elspeth to wait one more hour, explaining the Jeskai-Abzan tension over the dead.
timeline.quote: Dromoka all but informed the Abzan that their clan would be eradicated if they didn't forswear their ancestral worship.

timeline.summary: Khan Felothar receives Narset and Elspeth before the Council of Houses and insists on lengthy hospitality, delaying their mission.
timeline.quote: We have all the time in the world.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Ajani are reunited and speak of Melira's sacrifice and the past he cannot leave.
timeline.quote: She died saving me,

timeline.summary: Ajani asks Felothar to release Narset and Elspeth without waiting for consensus so they can try to quell the dragonstorms.
timeline.quote: they need to go on their way to see if there is a way to quell the dragonstorms.

timeline.summary: Felothar frees the three and announces evacuation and fortification of Arashin.
timeline.quote: You three are free to go.

timeline.summary: Felothar declares the Abzan will focus on preparation and dismisses the visitors, providing them with supplies.
timeline.quote: You will be provisioned with whatever you might need.

timeline.summary: Ajani confesses to Elspeth that he joined Phyrexia willingly and apologizes for trying to kill her.
timeline.quote: I was not forced. I was not compelled. I did it willingly.

timeline.summary: Elspeth tells Ajani he was forgiven before their fight began, and Narset invites him to help stop the dragonstorms.
timeline.quote: You were forgiven before our fight even began.

timeline.summary: Ajani refuses to join them and walks away.
timeline.quote: And he was gone before Elspeth or Narset could say another word

timeline.summary: Narset and Elspeth step into the dragonstorm, shielded by blue light, and walk toward a bright light amid forming dragons.
timeline.quote: Narset stepped into the storm and Elspeth followed.

timeline.summary: The storm falls silent and they find a massive ancient temple that Narset does not recognize from any records.
timeline.quote: There is a temple in the heart of the storms,

timeline.summary: Narset and Elspeth find an Omenpath in a subterranean antechamber and step through.
timeline.quote: Nothing to do but step through, then,

timeline.summary: Elspeth sees endless water while Narset sees stairs, and they realize this Meditation Realm is a distraction hiding something.
timeline.quote: The Meditation Realm. I've been here before.

timeline.summary: Narset hears a weeping voice whispering a name, and Jace Beleren appears.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren stood on a rime of white sand

timeline.summary: Jace reveals he escaped compleation by force of will, and Narset theorizes how.
timeline.quote: I was on my way to that, yes. But I am not anymore.

timeline.summary: Jace introduces Loot, a creature whose mind holds a map of every Omenpath, and Narset questions whether Loot consented to this state.
timeline.quote: He is a map of everything .

timeline.summary: Jace evades Elspeth's question, saying he did what he needed to.
timeline.quote: What I needed to.

timeline.summary: In the present, Jace says they are trapped in the Meditation Realm, and Narset tells her companions to empty their minds so the realm stops fighting.
timeline.quote: It's our thoughts that are trapping us in this shifting space.

timeline.summary: The realm reveals Ugin and a chained dragon together.
timeline.quote: revealing two figures that Narset would have known even in death

timeline.summary: Ugin warns them away, and Bolas, who has lost his memories, says he recognizes the three and calls Jace an accomplice.
timeline.quote: That you, perhaps, were an accomplice

timeline.summary: Narset asks Ugin for help against the dragonstorms and he says he cannot.
timeline.quote: I am sorry, but there is nothing I can do.

timeline.summary: Bolas learns his name from Elspeth's argument and begins to remember.
timeline.quote: Is that my name?

timeline.summary: Jace, who has already shifted to an illusory double, seizes the gem between Ugin's horns and an explosion of light follows.
timeline.quote: Jace closed his hands over the gleaming jewel suspended between Ugin's horns

timeline.summary: Jace reveals he wants to reverse Phyrexia's damage and control the realm; Elspeth attacks him and Narset protects her.
timeline.quote: What if I say that I can reverse everything?

timeline.summary: Narset rescues the terrified Loot as Elspeth fights Jace.
timeline.quote: I've got you,

timeline.summary: Vraska appears, changed and grief-worn, and tells Jace to stop.
timeline.quote: It was Vraska herself.

timeline.summary: Jace shatters like glass as emptiness rolls over him, and Elspeth tells Narset to run.
timeline.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

timeline.summary: Elspeth carries Narset and Loot through the Omenpath into the temple, where Vraska takes Loot.
timeline.quote: they were on the other side: outside the temple, Elspeth in the air, Vraska somehow beside her, arms held out for Loot.

timeline.summary: Narset climbs out and sees the sky black with dragons, and Elspeth names Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: "He's here."

timeline.summary: Vraska escapes with Loot under a camouflage spell as Narset and Elspeth decide to stand against Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: Tarkir is my home.

timeline.summary: Elspeth challenges Sarkhan in the air and says she is not afraid of him.
timeline.quote: I am not afraid of you.

timeline.summary: Elspeth plunges toward Sarkhan's open mouth as her last stand.
timeline.quote: Elspeth pulled her wings close to her back, plummeting through the sky like a stone

timeline.summary: Elspeth is clasped in Sarkhan's jaws while Ajani appeals to him, and Narset asks about the ritual and its sacrifice.
timeline.quote: What did you cut out of yourself to corrupt the spell?

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, stung with shame, vows to bathe the Multiverse in fire and goes after Elspeth.
timeline.quote: I want to bathe the Multiverse in fire for what it has done to me.

timeline.summary: Ajani catches the falling Elspeth and says he came to fight with her in the present.
timeline.quote: To fight with you in the present.

timeline.summary: Abzan dragons suffer mounting casualties, and Narset, Ajani and Elspeth plan to blind Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: If each of us goes for one of his eyes, we might be able to blind him

timeline.summary: Ajani recounts that Jace lost control of an unidentifiable spell in the Meditation Realm and dissolved into light and energy.
timeline.quote: The spell took him, and he was gone. Just light and energy on the wind.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Ajani that Jace is alive and still inside her head after what he did on Avishkar.
timeline.quote: Jace is alive,

timeline.summary: The God of Destiny artificially creates Calix on Theros to keep Elspeth Tirel from escaping the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Calix was artificially created by the God of Destiny on the plane of Theros to prevent Elspeth Tirel from escaping the Underworld.

timeline.summary: Calix fails in his duty and his fated purpose ignites his Spark, letting him pursue Elspeth across the multiverse.
timeline.quote: When Calix failed in his duty, his fated purpose ignited his Spark, allowing him to pursue Elspeth across the multiverse.

timeline.summary: As a child, Elspeth's plane is invaded by the Phyrexians and she is taken captive.
timeline.quote: As a child, her plane was invaded by the horrifying Phyrexians.

timeline.summary: Elspeth escapes captivity when her Spark ignites and has since searched for a new home.
timeline.quote: Taken captive, she escaped when her Spark ignited and has since searched for a new home.

timeline.summary: Koth, Elspeth and Venser cannot turn the tide, and Venser sacrifices his life to restore Karn to sanity.
timeline.quote: Venser sacrificed his life to restore Karn to sanity.

pages_say.description: A human planeswalker from Phyrexia-threatened worlds who was Heliod's champion, struck down Xenagos with Godsend, and was murdered by Heliod.
A human planeswalker and Ajani's friend who left Dominaria for Mirrodin; Ajani suspects she is the latest Champion of the Sun on Theros.
A human Planeswalker traveling on the Monsoon toward Kruphix's temple; Thassa calls her the Betrayer.
Ajani's dead friend and hero, a planeswalker whose white cloak he keeps.
A planeswalker who, in a flashback, is fatally wounded by Heliod after slaying Xenagos, and who now arrives on New Capenna searching for a place to call home.
A planeswalker doing odd jobs in New Capenna while searching for home, who has returned from death and fights Maestro enforcers.
A planeswalker working as a Maestros recruit to uncover how New Capenna beat the Phyrexians, who infiltrates the Cabaretti for Xander.
A human planeswalker who escaped Norn's Basilica; Ashiok found her in Theros's Underworld and uses a nightmare version of her against Norn.
A planeswalker who found Ajani alive and now mourns him; she warns the plan against New Phyrexia is a death sentence, then stays to defend the tower.
A planeswalker whose former cloak Ajani now wears.
A planeswalker and former knight of Bant who commands the tower's mechanical garrison and defends it with Jodah against a Phyrexian attack.
A planeswalker who survives the blast and joins the strike team for New Phyrexia.
A planeswalker defending the tower who tells Kaya and Saheeli the Phyrexians are close.
A planeswalker and warrior who knows Mirrodin from the earlier war; she is immune to Phyrexian infection and reunites with Koth.
A planeswalker and warrior who carries the Halo and fights alongside the strike team, riding down with Mirran cart operators.
A planeswalker and warrior who leads the survivors toward the Seedcore and faces her former mentor Ajani.
A planeswalker and warrior who defeats Ajani and then kills Jace and carries the activated sylex away.
A planeswalker whose weapon struck Rona and whom Tezzeret presents as the leader of the enemy.
A planeswalker who ran Jace through and carried the sylex into the Blind Eternities.
A planeswalker and sword-wielding protector who, in a dreamlike vision, is shown the invasions and chooses to protect Wrenn's mission at the Invasion Tree, being reborn with wings.
A planeswalker reborn as a winged angel in golden armor who arrives to save Karn and fights Elesh Norn so the Mirrans can escape.
A winged angel who strikes Nissa with light, catches Chandra and later fights the Grand Praetor.
A winged angel now serene and immortal who counsels Koth.
A winged angel and swordswoman who fights on New Phyrexia and tells Teferi to leave Nissa to her.
The planeswalker whose sword left a wound in Jace's chest.
A planeswalker who says 'Fear is the last thing to leave' before battles.
A radiant archangel who fights the dragon, heals Chandra and warns of dragon outbreaks.
A winged woman with glowing eyes who has arrived on Tarkir seeking Narset; Narset names her and fears something terrible has happened.
A planeswalker who has ascended to an archangel, arriving on Tarkir to ask how it has kept dragonstorms at bay; she helps fight a wild dragon.
An archangel and planeswalker whose ascension seems to have burned away much of her humanity; she accompanies Narset to the Crucible.
An archangel and planeswalker who is impatient with the Abzan delay and shows raw emotion on seeing Ajani.
An archangel and planeswalker with candle-flame glowing eyes who forgives Ajani and travels with Narset into the dragonstorms.
An archangel and planeswalker who attacks Jace to stop him taking control of the realm.
An archangel who stands against Sarkhan in a last stand to buy time and is saved by Ajani.
A planeswalker who helped Ajani stop the dragonstorms on Tarkir.
A planeswalker who helped with triage when Chandra was hurt on Avishkar.
A planeswalker Calix was created to stop from escaping the Underworld.
A brave knight and planeswalker with a strong sense of duty and mastery of radiant magic, who searches for a new home and peace.
A planeswalker who could not turn the tide against the Phyrexians.
